newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT ACT 41-29 IN SUPER 12.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT ACT 41-29 IN SUPER 12.

text.p: The Auckland Blues beat the ACT Brumbies 41-29 (half-time 15-3) in their Super 12 rugby match in Pukekohe, Auckland, on Saturday.
Auckland Blues - Tries: Eroni Clarke (2), Lee Stensness, Leo Lafaialii, Brian Lima, Adrian Cashmore. Penalties: Cashmore. Conversions: Cashmore (3), Carlos Spencer.
ACT Brumbies - Tries: Joe Roff, Rod Kafer, Stephen Larkham, Ipolito Fenukitau. Penalties: David Knox. Conversions: Knox, Roff (2).
